hooks.command: T=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/memhub-codex-hook.XXXXXX"); cat > "$T"; R=$(ls -d $HOME/.codex/plugins/cache/*/memhub/*/ 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1); if [ -n "$R" ]; then nohup sh -c 'python3 "$1scripts/codex_flush.py" Stop < "$2"; rm -f "$2"' -- "$R" "$T" >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi

T=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/memhub-codex-hook.XXXXXX"); cat > "$T"; R=$(ls -d $HOME/.codex/plugins/cache/*/memhub/*/ 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1); if [ -n "$R" ]; then nohup sh -c 'python3 "$1scripts/codex_flush.py" PostToolUse < "$2"; rm -f "$2"' -- "$R" "$T" >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi
